briefdescription.para: Mask for PUF control bits in PUF_ECC_PUF_CTRL register.
Returns XST_SUCCESS when the cache region has at least one programmed (non-zero) row.

parameterdescription.para: - First cache byte offset in the region.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when reads are consistent and at least one row is non-zero.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_IN_PROTECTION_CHECK on read mismatch or if every row is zero.

simplesect.para: Scans from StartOffset; stops at the first non-zero row.

briefdescription.para: This function programs Puf control bits specified by user.

parameterdescription.para: - Environmental monitoring flag set by the user, when set to true it will not check for voltage and temperature limits.

listitem.para: XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_WRITE_PUF_SEC_CTRL_BITS Error while writing PUF security control bits (REGIS_DIS, HD_INVLD, REGEN_DIS).

briefdescription.para: This function programs PUF ctrl and PUF helper data, Chash and Aux.

listitem.para: XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_WRITE_PUF_HELPER_DATA Error while writing Puf helper data.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_WRITE_PUF_SYN_DATA Error while writing Puf Syndata.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_WRITE_PUF_CHASH Error while writing Puf Chash.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_WRITE_PUF_AUX Error while writing Puf Aux.

simplesect.para: To generate PufSyndromeData please use XPuf_Registration API.

briefdescription.para: Runs Versal Net protection checks after cache reload.

detaileddescription.para: Protection status bits live in TBITS0_SVD. Each active protection bit requires its protected fuse region to be programmed.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when all active protection rules pass.

briefdescription.para: Platform PUF eFuse programming (helper data and user-fuse modes).

simplesect.para: PUF compile-time split (XNVM_ACCESS_PUF_USER_DATA): undefined (default) — XNvm_EfuseWritePuf() via band engine. defined — XNvm_EfuseWritePufAsUserFuses() with dynamic COMPUTE_PRG bands. XNvm_EfuseWritePufSecCtrl() is built in both configurations.
